entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You're speaking with Charlie at VeloFit. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I'm trying to make a return, I think. The website was a little overwhelming, and I'm not sure if I'm doing it right.
I can definitely help you with that. Can I start with your name and the order number, please?
Yes, the name is Alex Smith, and the order number is... VF789012. It's for that helmet I ordered.
Got it, Alex. I see the order right here. So I can understand the situation, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, no, nothing's wrong with it. I... I just don't like the color. It looked different online. My partner said I should just send it back. The box is unopened, still sealed and everything. I just got so confused with the return portal. Can't you just help me?
Of course, that's what I'm here for. Let me just confirm the delivery date for you. I see it arrived about 40 days ago.
Is that okay? I wasn't sure what the time limit was. I feel a bit helpless with all these rules.
It's absolutely fine. For standard gear like this, our policy allows for returns up to 90 days after delivery. Your request is well within that window.
Oh, really? So I can return it for a refund?

Yes, absolutely. We want to make sure you're completely satisfied with your gear, especially when it comes to something as important as safety. I've just approved the return in our system. I'm emailing you a prepaid shipping label right now. You just need to print it and attach it to the shipping box.
Wow, that's a huge relief. Thank you so much, Charlie. That was much easier than I expected.
You're very welcome, Alex. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
